facts.fact: Zambia's Ministry of Technology and Science says the Cyber Security Bill (N.A.B. 29/2024) and Cyber Crimes Bill (N.A.B. 30/2024) were amended in eight clauses and a Notice of Amendments issued to Parliament for resubmission.
facts.system: Cyber Security Bill and Cyber Crimes Bill

facts.fact: The ministry refers to the review of the Cyber Security and Cybercrimes Act No. 2 of 2021, which it says it consulted on in 2022 and 2024.
facts.system: Cyber Security and Cybercrimes Act No. 2 of 2021

systems.system: Cyber Security and Cybercrimes Act No. 2 of 2021
